name: Mozzarella, part-skim (USDA reference)
basis: Generic part-skim reference only. Per 1 oz: sodium 175 mg, potassium 24 mg, phosphorus 131 mg, protein 6.9 g. Fresh, whole-milk, shredded and branded products vary; check the exact package. Dairy is not a high-purine trigger food, but food choices do not replace gout treatment.
alternatives: Compare the package sodium and serving size with your care plan; ask your renal dietitian whether another cheese fits your plan.

name: White rice, cooked
basis: Plain rice is a lower-sodium staple; preparation and portion still matter.

name: Oatmeal, plain
basis: Plant purines are not automatically forbidden; portions and kidney labs matter.

name: Potato, baked
basis: Potassium restriction depends on labs and medicines; this flag is not a universal ban.

name: Tomato
basis: Portion and preparation change nutrient content; follow your personal lab-based plan.

name: Banana
basis: Potassium restriction depends on labs and medicines; it is not automatically restricted.

name: Apple
basis: A basic low-flag reference; portion and individual care plan still matter.

name: Avocado
basis: Potassium restriction depends on labs and medicines; this flag is not a universal ban.

name: Beans or lentils, cooked
basis: Plant purines are not automatically forbidden; potassium/phosphorus restrictions depend on labs.

name: Spinach, cooked
basis: Potassium restriction depends on labs and medicines.

name: Liver / organ meats
basis: The guide advises limiting organ meats for gout; nutrient values vary.

name: Beef, red meat
basis: The guide advises limiting frequent large portions of red meat; protein needs are individualized.

name: Processed deli meat
basis: Processed meat can combine gout concerns with high sodium; check for phosphate additives.

name: Sardines / anchovies
basis: The guide identifies some seafood as a food to limit; sodium varies by brand.

name: Shellfish
basis: Some seafood is identified in gout guidance for moderation; CKD nutrients vary.

name: Beer
basis: The guide recommends limiting alcohol with gout; a prescribed fluid plan may also apply.

name: Spirits / liquor
basis: The guide recommends limiting alcohol with gout; a prescribed fluid plan may also apply.

name: Sugar-sweetened soda
basis: The guide recommends limiting sugary drinks and high-fructose corn syrup.

name: Water
basis: Drink according to any fluid plan prescribed for kidney or heart health.

name: Low-fat milk
basis: Phosphorus, potassium and protein portions depend on labs and dietitian advice.

name: Egg
basis: Fit protein and phosphorus to your individual plan.

name: Chicken, unprocessed
basis: CKD protein needs are individualized; added phosphate and sodium vary by processing.

name: Instant noodles / ramen
basis: Packaged foods may be high in sodium or contain phosphate additives; check the label.

name: Protein powder / high-protein supplement
basis: Avoid high-protein supplements unless your clinician or dietitian advises them.

name: Plain low-fat yogurt
basis: Phosphorus, potassium and protein portions depend on labs and dietitian advice.

name: Canned soup
basis: Canned foods may contain substantial sodium; compare labels and serving size.
